svg.title: AI Support Agent — Automated query pipeline
svg.desc: AI Support Agent — Automated query pipeline. Status: Built. Problem: Support teams spend most of their time on routine questions, and escalations arrive without context. Approach: Claude / GPT-4o with function calling resolves routine queries and escalates the rest with the context already drafted. Highlights: Classifies intent and urgency for every inbound query; Routine queries: auto-reply + logged to the CRM; Needs judgment: human review with context pre-drafted; Multi-model with function calling and webhooks. Stack: Node.js, Claude, GPT-4o, Supabase, Function calling, Webhooks.
